scope: Optional conservative adapter mode over existing base-stat actions; exact-base files retain original guards

source.locator: Major Arcana Temperance effect: additional social-stat points, one-day duration; Reload context

bonusIdentity: Temporary Temperance shuffle-card effect, not the Temperance social link rank

preconditionPolicy.reason: The sourced effect adds points; ignoring it preserves the base-gain lower bound
preconditionPolicy.allOtherGuardsRemain: date/slot/location/funds/menu unlock/challenge result and other source conditions still required

effectPolicy.baseStatDelta: Use as guaranteed lower-bound increase under cited base-action assumptions, never an exact observed delta
effectPolicy.rankInference: Prove rank threshold only from lower bound; crossing in upper range alone is uncertain
effectPolicy.actualReconciliation: A player-observed new stat rank narrows interval; do not overwrite their observation with forecast
effectPolicy.noNegativeEffectAssumption: If a separate negative/variant effect is encountered or source conditions are unknown, invalidate this deduction and observe
